camera.reason: 50MP main with autofocus plus a 5MP ultrawide, no OIS.

performance.reason: Helio G99 is smooth in daily use and handles light to medium gaming.

battery.reason: 5,000mAh with 25W charging lasts a full day.

display.reason: FHD+ Super AMOLED, but only 90Hz and about 800 nits.

build.reason: Glass front, plastic back and frame, IP54 splash resistance.

software.reason: Samsung promises 6 Android upgrades and 6 years of security patches.

value.reason: Six years of updates is unmatched here, but 90Hz and 25W trail the Redmi Note 14.

availability.reason: Out of stock at PriceOye and gone from Samsung Pakistan's site; only a third-party Daraz seller lists it.

notes: Pakistan model is the 4G SM-A165F. Price is the WhatMobile official 6GB 128GB figure. PriceOye lists the 6GB 128GB at 46,999 and the 8GB 256GB at 56,499, both out of stock on 2026-10-10. A non-official Daraz seller lists the 8GB 256GB at 61,999. Samsung Pakistan's Galaxy A page now shows the A17 instead. Release date is the mid-October 2024 announcement; exact day unverified.
